value.query: WITH SALES_MIN_WEEK_DATE_CTE AS ( SELECT DATEADD(WEEK, -109, (SELECT MAX(IMS_WEEK_DATE) FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_1},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_2}))) AS SALES_MIN_WEEK_DATE ), SUBNATIONAL_MIN_WEEK_DATE_CTE AS ( SELECT DATEADD(WEEK, -109, (SELECT MAX(IMS_WEEK_DATE) FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_3},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_4},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_5}))) AS SUBNATIONAL_MIN_WEEK_DATE ), RETAIL_SALES_CTE AS ( SELECT RX.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, RX.IMS_NUMBER, RX.ABV_PRODUCT_ID, RX.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME, MDM.PRODUCT_NAME, CUST.DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG AS CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, CUST.PRESCRIBER_FLAG, RX.MARKET_ID, RX.IMS_WEEK_DATE, RX.TOTAL_RX_COUNT, RX.REFILL_RX_COUNT, RX.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, IMS_NUMBER, ABV_PRODUCT_ID, MARKET_ID, DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME, IMS_WEEK_DATE, SUM(TOTAL_RX_COUNT) AS TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS REFILL_RX_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_1},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_2},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_3},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_4},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_5}) AND DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({PSYCH_DSP_NAME_1},{PSYCH_DSP_NAME_2},{PSYCH_DSP_NAME_3}) AND (( MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_1},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_2}) AND IMS_WEEK_DATE >= (SELECT SALES_MIN_WEEK_DATE FROM SALES_MIN_WEEK_DATE_CTE)) OR ( MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_3},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_4},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_5}) AND IMS_WEEK_DATE >= (SELECT SUBNATIONAL_MIN_WEEK_DATE FROM SUBNATIONAL_MIN_WEEK_DATE_CTE))) GROUP BY ALL ) RX INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG, PRESCRIBER_FLAG FROM {SCHEMA_DIM}.{SRC_CUST_VW} WHERE UPPER(TRIM(DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG))={ACTIVE_FLAG} ) CUST ON RX.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID=CUST.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_NAME, ABV_PRODUCT_ID FROM {SCHEMA_DIM}.{SRC_PROD_VW} WHERE UPPER(TRIM(DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG))={ACTIVE_FLAG} ) MDM ON RX.ABV_PRODUCT_ID=CAST(MDM.ABV_PRODUCT_ID AS VARCHAR) ), PRIORITIZED_MAPPING AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT, PRODUCT_PATTERN, PRIORITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY PRIORITY) AS RN FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT R.PRODUCT_NAME, TRIM(M.PRODUCT) AS PRODUCT, TRIM(M.PRODUCT_PATTERN) AS PRODUCT_PATTERN, M.PRIORITY FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R JOIN {SCHEMA_FFP_NEURO}.{SRC_PRD_MAPP} M ON UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE UPPER(TRIM(M.PRODUCT_PATTERN)) WHERE R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({PSYCH_DSP_NAME_1},{PSYCH_DSP_NAME_2},{PSYCH_DSP_NAME_3}) ) SUB ), SALES_SUBNATIONAL_COMBINED AS ( SELECT CAST(R.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID AS STRING) AS ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, R.IMS_WEEK_DATE AS WEEK_DATE, {PSYCH_IND_CODE_1} AS INDICATION, COALESCE(M.PRODUCT, {INVALID_CHARACTER_3}) AS PRODUCT, R.CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG AS SALES_CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, R.PRESCRIBER_FLAG AS SALES_PRESCRIBER_FLAG, SUM( CASE WHEN R.MARKET_ID = {PSYCH_MKT_ID_1} THEN R.TOTAL_RX_COUNT ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END ) AS SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(R.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT, SUM(R.REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R LEFT JOIN PRIORITIZED_MAPPING M ON R.PRODUCT_NAME = M.PRODUCT_NAME AND M.RN = {DEFAULT_UNIT} WHERE R.MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_1},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_2}) AND R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({PSYCH_DSP_NAME_1},{PSYCH_DSP_NAME_2}) AND M.PRODUCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(R.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID AS STRING) AS ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, R.IMS_WEEK_DATE AS WEEK_DATE, CASE WHEN (MARKET_ID = {PSYCH_MKT_ID_3}) THEN {PSYCH_IND_CODE_2} WHEN (MARKET_ID = {PSYCH_MKT_ID_4}) THEN {PSYCH_IND_CODE_3} WHEN (MARKET_ID = {PSYCH_MKT_ID_5}) THEN {PSYCH_IND_CODE_4} END AS INDICATION, COALESCE(M.PRODUCT, {INVALID_CHARACTER_3}) AS PRODUCT, R.CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG AS SALES_CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, R.PRESCRIBER_FLAG AS SALES_PRESCRIBER_FLAG, SUM(R.TOTAL_RX_COUNT) AS SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(R.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT, SUM(R.REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R LEFT JOIN PRIORITIZED_MAPPING M ON R.PRODUCT_NAME = M.PRODUCT_NAME AND M.RN = {DEFAULT_UNIT} WHERE R.MARKET_ID IN ({PSYCH_MKT_ID_3},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_4},{PSYCH_MKT_ID_5}) AND R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({PSYCH_DSP_NAME_3}) AND M.PRODUCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 ) SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, WEEK_DATE, INDICATION AS INDICATION_CODE, PRODUCT AS BRAND_NAME, CASE WHEN SUM(SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, INDICATION, PRODUCT ORDER BY WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING_12} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= {ACTIVE_WRITER_THRESHOLD} THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE {INACTIVE_FLAG} END AS SALES_NBRX_WRITER_FLAG, CASE WHEN SUM(SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, INDICATION, PRODUCT ORDER BY WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING_12} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= {ACTIVE_WRITER_THRESHOLD} THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE {INACTIVE_FLAG} END AS SALES_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX_WRITER_FLAG, CASE WHEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, INDICATION, PRODUCT ORDER BY WEEK_DATE) = {DEFAULT_UNIT} AND SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT >= {ACTIVE_WRITER_THRESHOLD}) OR (SUM(SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, INDICATION, PRODUCT ORDER BY WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING_52} PRECEDING AND {DEFAULT_UNIT} PRECEDING) < {ACTIVE_WRITER_THRESHOLD} AND SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT >= {ACTIVE_WRITER_THRESHOLD}) THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE {INACTIVE_FLAG} END AS SALES_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX_NEW_WRITER_FLAG, SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT AS SALES_NORMALIZED_TRX, SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT AS SALES_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX, SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT AS SALES_NBRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_TRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_NBRX, NULL AS BPD_SCZ_DECILE, NULL AS MDD_DECILE FROM SALES_SUBNATIONAL_COMBINED
